camel_example: aliyun dcdn CreateDcdnWafGroup --region cn-hangzhou --Subscribe on --TemplateId 0 --Name test
description_en: The CreateDcdnWafGroup operation creates a custom WAF rule group
description_zh: 调用CreateDcdnWafGroup创建自定义WAF规则组
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn create-dcdn-waf-group --name test --template-id 0 --subscribe on --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDcdnWafGroup

parameters.help_en: The name of the WAF rule group. The name can be up to 128 characters in length. This parameter is required when you create a custom WAF rule group
parameters.help_zh: WAF规则组名称，最大128字符。新建自定义WAF规则组时必填
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the rule group to copy. This parameter is required when you copy a custom WAF rule group. You can call the [DescribeDcdnWafGroups](~~DescribeDcdnWafGroups~~) operation to query the ID of the rule group. If you do not use a template, set this parameter to 0 or leave it unspecified
parameters.help_zh:
待复制规则组ID。
复制自定义WAF规则组时必填。
您可以通过[DescribeDcdnWafGroups](~~DescribeDcdnWafGroups~~)接口查询对应的规则组ID。无模板传0或不传
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to subscribe to the rule group. Valid values:

on: The subscription is enabled.
off: The subscription is disabled.

Do not specify this parameter when you copy another custom rule group
parameters.help_zh:
是否订阅：取值：
on：开启
off：关闭

复制其他自定义规则组时不传
parameters.name: subscribe

Id.description_en: The ID of the WAF rule group that was created
